newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends at highs in robust volume.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends at highs in robust volume.

text.p: Fresh buying and short-covering by the funds lifted CSCE world sugar futures sharply higher and over nearby resistance seen at 10.89 cents in March, dealers said.

The trade stood on the opposite side of the market led by the producers, who were cited as steady scale-up sellers. One dealer said between 300 to 500 lots were probably sold from 10.84 at each tick higher.
"What it came to is steady fund buying, which gradually eroded scale-up selling," he said. "It was like a diagonal line: a very steady ascent reaching 10.90 on close."
The most-active March contract finished on resistance at 10.89, up 0.16, traded 10.90 to 10.73. The back months settled 0.16 to 0.11 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 20,856 lots, which included 966 against actuals in March.
Floor sources said today's close could signal firmer prices ahead of New Year's holiday.
But the trade will probably remain a steady seller into rallies, providing an obstacle to firm resistance pegged between 11.00 and 11.05 cents.
"I'm leaning towards the producers winning out," a trader said. "With a good crop forecast, there is more selling they can do."
Support was pegged between 10.65 and 10.60 in March.
